app.title: Muru – AI-assisted Rust server for Python apps by mod_WSGI's creator
app.description: A Rust‑backed server that executes Python WSGI applications, combining Rust performance with Python's ecosystem and providing AI‑assisted tooling for deployment and debugging.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and build the binary with cargo build --release.
Deploy a simple Python Flask app using Muru and send an HTTP GET request to verify the correct response.
Benchmark the response latency of the same Flask app running under Muru vs mod_wsgi and compare performance.
Run Muru's AI assistance feature on a sample codebase and confirm that the suggested optimizations are applied.
Package Muru as a Docker image and deploy it to a local Kubernetes cluster, ensuring the pod starts successfully.
